searchDocs.title: ZoneOptions​
searchDocs.content: </> interface ZoneOptions { MaxHeight: number?-- Maximum distance from the part's centre along its up axis. AboveOnly: boolean?-- Only count points on or above the part's centre plane. }

searchDocs.title: Entered​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D.Entered: Signal<Model > Fires when a tracked model's PrimaryPart enters the zone.

searchDocs.title: Exited​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D.Exited: Signal<Model > Fires when a tracked model leaves the zone, is untracked while inside, or leaves the workspace.

searchDocs.title: IsPointInside​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D.IsPointInside( part: BasePart , position: Vector3 , options: ZoneOptions? ) → boolean Checks whether a world position is inside a part's footprint without creating a zone.

searchDocs.title: new​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D.new( part: BasePart , options: ZoneOptions? ) → Zone2D Creates a zone from a part's footprint. The zone checks tracked models every Heartbeat.

searchDocs.title: IsInside​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:IsInside(position: Vector3 ) → boolean Checks whether a world position is inside this zone.

searchDocs.title: TrackModel​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:TrackModel(model: Model ) → () Tracks a model to detect when it enters/exits the zone. The model must be parented to workspace. Detection begins once it has a PrimaryPart.

searchDocs.title: UntrackModel​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:UntrackModel(model: Model ) → () Stops tracking a model. If the model was inside the zone, it will fire the Exited event.

searchDocs.title: TrackPlayers​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:TrackPlayers() → () Convenience function to track all player characters. Automatically tracks new players and characters as they are added.

searchDocs.title: GetModelsInside​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:GetModelsInside() → {Model } Returns a list of all models currently inside the zone.

searchDocs.title: Destroy​
searchDocs.content: </> Zone2D:Destroy() → () Destroys the Zone2D instance and disconnects all connections. After calling this, the instance should not be used.
